lead_fa: هستهٔ بازی Holy Priest دو اسپل شاخص است: [[Holy Word: Serenity]] برای شفای تک‌هدف و [[Holy Word: Sanctify]] برای شفای گروهی؛ کست‌های [[Flash Heal]] و [[Prayer of Healing]] و [[Renew]] این دو را شارژ می‌کنند و تو دائماً بین ساختن و خرج‌کردن آن‌ها می‌چرخی. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Oracle]] با دو شارژ [[Prayer of Mending]] و بازی تک‌هدف‌محور، و [[Archon]] با [[Halo]] و [[Apotheosis]] برای برست سنگین گروهی. در Midnight Season 2 انتخاب اول برای Raid و Mythic+ اوراکل است و آرکن برای Delves و رییدهای ۳۰ نفره جذاب می‌شود.

strengths: Flexible healing profile thanks to Miracle Worker: every direct heal leaves a Mastery: Echo of Light HoT
Powerful healing cooldowns and multiple instant cast spells
Spirit of Redemption lets you keep healing through death for a short period
Strong spot-healing and triage: competitive single-target and AoE builds across talents
weaknesses: Poor mobility makes high-movement encounters challenging
Lacks personal defensive strength compared to other healers

buffs: Divine Hymn additionally grants Guardian Spirit to you while channeled (patch 12.1)
Apotheosis now reduces Holy Word mana cost by 70% (was 50%)
Benediction (Rank 3 apex talent) reworked: Holy Word: Serenity upgrades the next Flash Heal into Benediction with 100% chance; Apotheosis no longer upgrades Flash Heal
changes_12_1.note: Wowhead Holy guides updated 2026-10-13 for Midnight Season 2.

hero.recommendation: Oracle is the best Hero Talent for Raid and Mythic+ in Midnight Season 2 per Wowhead: two Prayer of Mending charges fund sustained passive healing and the build focuses single-target healing through Flash Heal. Archon is the Delve pick and can be stronger than Oracle in 30-player raids: Halo-focused burst paired with Apotheosis.
hero.archon: Empowers Halo (Archon only): longer duration, increased healing and 10 seconds of increased healing received for allies it touches; improves Apotheosis effectiveness, increases Holy Word: Serenity and Holy Word: Sanctify healing, and lets Surge of Light procs fuel Prayer of Healing.
hero.oracle: Prayer of Mending gains two charges for pooling during movement; talents heal allies directly when casting Prayer of Mending; Premonition was removed. The play drops Prayer of Healing entirely: Flash Heal makes up the majority of casts, feeding Dispersing Light cleaves and Ultimate Serenity's extra Serenity casts.
hero.comparison_source_note: Wowhead Best Holy Priest Talent Tree Builds (AutomaticJak, updated 2026-10-13): Oracle carries the Best tags for Raid and Mythic+; Archon listed for Delves.

builds.notes: Oracle Raid focuses heavy Flash Heal casting for Dispersing Light with lots of Prayer of Mending and Serenity casts under Ultimate Serenity. Oracle Mythic+ drops Prayer of Healing and takes Holy Fire related talents to optimize damage during downtime. Archon Delves takes most crowd control tools for solo or group delves. In 30-player raids Archon can be stronger than Oracle.

concepts: Keep Holy Words on cooldown: Holy Word: Serenity and Holy Word: Sanctify are the most powerful abilities; pool them only briefly for predictable damage, never sit on 2 stacks
Raid healing is flexible between AoE and single-target: spot-healing (triage) is at a premium in progression raiding where most healers spread even AoE healing
Mythic+ healing is flexible thanks to Ultimate Serenity: Prayer of Healing stays available while extra Holy Word: Serenity casts cleave the party
Healing follows a priority list rather than a strict rotation: build up and spend Holy Words for the best effect
Have one Holy Word: Serenity charge ready before activating Apotheosis to benefit from the cost discount and increased healing
Spread Renew: with the 4pc set bonus every Prayer of Mending target is guaranteed a Renew, so prioritize allies without Renew
st_priority: Cast Holy Word: Serenity for single target healing on cooldown
Keep Prayer of Mending on cooldown; pool a charge when you know you must move
Cast Flash Heal to spot-heal; do not overcap Benediction stacks (2)
Cast Smite during downtime to farm Surge of Light procs
Cast Divine Hymn for raid-wide damage
archon_raid_priority: Cast Halo as raid damage begins so it expands and contracts through the damage window
Cast Apotheosis to reset the cooldowns of your Holy Words
Cast Holy Word: Serenity for single target healing on cooldown
Consume Surge of Light procs on Prayer of Healing whenever possible; you can hold up to two stacks
Keep Prayer of Mending on cooldown
Cast Flash Heal to spot-heal; do not overcap Benediction stacks (2)
Cast Smite during downtime to farm Surge of Light procs
Cast Divine Hymn for raid-wide damage
mplus_priority: Cast Prayer of Mending on cooldown, preferring allies who need direct healing or lack stacks
Cast Halo frequently for healing and damage, ideally before incoming damage to bank Surge of Light procs (they heal for more)
Cast Holy Word: Serenity on cooldown for single target
Use Apotheosis frequently to save mana and reset Holy Word cooldowns for burst windows, or as a damage cooldown during downtime
Use Flash Heal and make sure to not overcap (2) on Benediction stacks
Hold Holy Words ahead of predictable boss mechanics
rotation.aoe_note: Archon treats Prayer of Healing as a mana burn for extra healing when mana allows; consume Surge of Light procs on Prayer of Healing (hold up to 2 stacks). Holy Word: Sanctify remains the AoE Holy Word and Renew spreads with Prayer of Mending through the 4pc bonus. Divine Hymn does bonus healing in dungeons.

cooldowns.Divine Hymn: Primary raid cooldown; castable while out of Line of Sight of allies; patch 12.1 grants you Guardian Spirit while channeling so ground effects cannot kill you; does bonus healing in dungeons
cooldowns.Apotheosis: Maximize Holy Word casts during its duration; reduces Holy Word mana cost by 70%; pool Surge of Light procs and cast Flash Heal or Prayer of Healing aggressively to generate Holy Words; every GCD during Apotheosis should cast or reduce a Holy Word
cooldowns.Guardian Spirit: Main tank external and cheat death returning the target to 40% health; especially valuable on tanks with strong self-healing like Blood DKs; self-cast when tanks are not using it
cooldowns.Desperate Prayer: Self defensive; one of your two primary personal defensives alongside Fade
cooldowns.Fade: Threat drop and defensive filler; pair with Desperate Prayer as your primary defensives
cooldowns.Protective Light: 10% damage reduction triggered by casting Flash Heal on any ally thanks to the Binding Heals passive

rotation.hero_notes: Archon: Halo lasts longer, heals more and increases healing allies receive for 10 seconds; use Halo early as damage hits, pair it with Apotheosis (absolute must), and pool Holy Words without capping stacks for the increased healing window. Oracle: the extra Prayer of Mending charge funds passive healing and movement pooling; Prompt Prognosis gives efficient spot-healing; Piety is passive in Midnight and redirects overheal to allies in need; Unfolding Vision keeps Prayer of Mending stacks active in Mythic+; Prayer of Mending caps at 14 stacks and one cast applies 7, so refresh before overcap or waste.

gear.gearing_rules: Raid: Critical Strike > Versatility = Mastery > Haste for Archon; Oracle wants Haste to ~20% comfort first. Mythic+: Versatility first for Archon since defensives matter; Mastery lacks damage value in dungeons. Never neglect Intellect: a substantial item level increase usually beats optimized stats. Upgrades: with Ascendant Venomstones go Weapon > Trinkets > Neck; with Mistcrests go Weapon > high-budget slots (Chest, Legs, Helm) > strong Trinkets. Bonus-roll (Nebulous Voidcores) priority: Jan'thrazet, the Soul Fang > Venomkeeper's Horrific Cowl > Aqirbane Reliquary. Best embellishments: Arcanoweave Lining on BiS pieces, Hunter's Ritual Stone on the off-hand early in the season.

stats.cheatsheet: Raid (Archon): Intellect > Crit > Versatility = Mastery > Haste. Raid (Oracle): Intellect > Haste to ~20% comfort > Crit > Versatility = Mastery > Haste. Mythic+ (Archon): Intellect > Versatility > Crit > Haste > Mastery. Mythic+ (Oracle): Intellect > Haste to ~30% comfort > Versatility > Crit > Mastery.
notes: Critical Strike doubles healing on crit and increases the Echo of Light heal that follows direct heals.
Haste lowers cast time and the GCD, adds Renew ticks and reduces Prayer of Mending's cooldown; higher item level items often provide enough Haste for a comfortable flow.
Mastery: Echo of Light leaves a HoT on targets healed by your direct heals.
Versatility gives a linear gain in healing and reduces damage taken, which matters because personal defensives are weak.
stats.per_hero_or_mode: Raid: Archon goes Crit > Versatility = Mastery > Haste; Oracle wants Haste to ~20% comfort first then Crit > Versatility = Mastery. Mythic+: Archon goes Versatility > Critical Strike > Haste > Mastery; Oracle wants Haste to ~30% comfort then Versatility > Critical Strike.
stats.dr_breakpoints: Diminishing returns begin above 1380 rating for Critical Strike, 1320 for Haste, 1380 for Mastery and 1620 for Versatility; above each breakpoint additional rating gives 10% less. Percentage effects like Bloodlust are not counted.
